descript.abstract: A statewide coverage of major conveyances in California. These may include pipelines, canals, flumes,...etc. The original data were downloaded from the California Spaitial Information Library (CASIL): http://gis.ca.gov/index.epl. The data have subsequently been updated, modified or corrected where necessary based on the best available information which includes, but is not limited to USGS DOQQ, USGS 7.5' TopoQuads, AirPhotoUSA aerial imagery (conforms to USGS 1:24,000 mapping standards) and various source material provided by clients.
descript.purpose: Developed for use in mapping California's conveyances.
